title: WorkspacesReorderResult
description: Result of the workspaces.reorder JSON-RPC method: every workspace, in the new switcher order, with the positions the backend wrote. The call takes the WHOLE order and never a move — a partial list needs a second rule for where everything else goes, and two rules for one order disagree eventually — so a list that is not a permutation of the workspaces is refused and nothing moves.

workspaces.description: Every workspace, in position order. Never null: an empty array is the answer when there is nothing to order, and the renderer's first .map assumes it.
